deprecation.reason: This schema is now deprecated, in favor of the IEEE 1752.1 schema of the same name.

description: This schema represents a JSON Schema identifier.

namespace.description: The namespace of the schema. A namespace serves to disambiguate schemas with conflicting names.

version.description: The version of the schema, e.g. 1.0.

url.description: A URL to retrieve the schema. If a URL is not specified, it is assumed that the schema can be located using other means.
